audience: practitioners and practice managers who run a practice with Practice Better

useCases.title: Find open booking slots for a service
useCases.text: The AI reads the open booking slots of one practitioner for one service, with start, end and duration, and lists the services and practitioners to pick from.

useCases.title: Review the services and packages you offer
useCases.text: The AI lists services with name, duration, and group or 1-1 type, and the packages with name and SKU.

useCases.title: Check which invoices still have an amount due
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with number, date, totals, amount due and payment status, and opens one for its line items and tax.

useCases.title: List the practitioners and admins in the practice
useCases.text: The AI lists practitioners and admin users with role flags and activation status, plus the practice and time zone of your account.

useCases.title: See which forms the practice uses
useCases.text: The AI lists the form templates of the practice, such as intake, questionnaire and consent forms, by name.
